_help.implementation: Possible values: 'claude' (uses claude_agent_sdk) or 'gemini' (uses opencode CLI with gemini).
_help.gemini_api_key: Your Google Gemini API key. If empty, the agent assumes it is already exported in your environment.
_help.anthropic_api_key: Your Anthropic API key. This is OPTIONAL if you have an active Claude Code CLI subscription. If provided, it overrides the subscription to use your API key.
_help.gemini_model: The specific Gemini model to use with opencode CLI (e.g., 'google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview-customtools', 'google/gemini-2.5-flash').
